visualNotes: Brand identity: خدمت يار | KHIDMATYAR (@khidmatyar) — trusted, dignified, modest visual aesthetic.
Gold visual budget: restrained gold (#D4AF37) strictly <= 5% of total frame area over deep emerald (#071A12) / surface (#0D291D) and ivory (#F7F6F2) typography.
No icon rotation: keep all icons, badges, and geometric markers strictly upright and steady (zero spin or tilt animations).
Modest visuals: calm, respectful, culturally appropriate imagery and restrained motion without flashy neon or cluttered effects.
Typography: Vazirmatn, Cairo, sans-serif with strictly 0px letter-spacing on all RTL Arabic/Persian text.
